verdicts_or_reports.expected: Developer-only "Set XP" debug control is not shown on the player-facing Profile Skills list in a release build.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Every skill card on Profile > Skills (Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, Farming, Thieving, Smithing, Cooking, Fletching) shows a "[Debug] Set XP" button.
steps: Open the app with the starting character Aldric.
Tap Profile in the bottom navigation.
Profile opens on the Skills section (sidebar: Skills).
Look at the skill cards: each one, e.g. Mining, shows the label "[Debug] Set XP" under the skill name.

verdicts_or_reports.field: Header stats and achievements progress in landscape
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After rotating to landscape, the profile header (Coins 2.5M) and the achievements progress label (34%) and bar are fully visible and not covered by the system navigation buttons.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: In landscape the profile content runs under the right-hand system navigation strip: the "2.5M" coin value is clipped at the edge, and the "34%" progress label sits underneath the navigation buttons. The element list no longer reports the "2.5M" value at all.
steps: Open the app with the starting character Aldric.
Tap Profile in the bottom navigation; the Achievements section shows '13 / 38 obtained' and 34%.
Look at the header on the right edge: 'Coins' is shown but its value '2.5M' is clipped, and the '34%' label is hidden under the system navigation buttons.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The bonus list includes the Infinite Tower bonuses the character has earned (+7% XP from the tower; the +12% coin and +150 HP bonuses also listed under their own categories), alongside the prestige and Builder's Workshop entries.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The SKILL BONUSES list shows only Attack (Prestige +5% / +5% XP), Attack (+9 Boosts combat stats), Hitpoints (Prestige +5% / +5% XP), Hitpoints (+4 Boosts combat stats) and Construction (-7%, Builder's Workshop). No Infinite Tower entry appears anywhere in the list.
steps: Open the app with the starting character Aldric (Infinite Tower bonuses +7% XP, +12% coin drops, +150 HP earned).
Tap Profile in the bottom navigation, then tap Bonuses in the left sidebar.
Read the SKILL BONUSES list: it has 5 entries (Attack x2, Hitpoints x2, Construction).
No Infinite Tower bonus is listed.
